venue: Jacksonville, Florida (mid-size market, no deep wrestling-DNA — honest barometer crowd)
context: Go-home SmackDown before Backlash 2026 (Tampa, May 9). Episode titled 'Requiem for a Gingerbread'. Final show before PPV — ledger locks here.

segments.outcome: Fatu opens. Usos came out, words exchanged. Crowd getting behind Fatu. Aitu being accepted by population before institution installs him.
segments.notes: Crowd first, belt second. Conflict ideological — Fatu had words with Usos instead of superkicking. Civil war has a question, not just a fight.

segments.outcome: Pre-taped package — no makeup, vulnerable register. Wished Tiffany well before her match.
segments.notes: Two halves of real-life partnership in different states of presence. Inter-gender title watch flag.

segments.outcome: Tiffany def. Kiana (retains Women's US). Kiana had it. Giulia's mistimed assist distracted ref → Tiffany capitalized.
segments.notes: Strong-loss for Kiana. Giulia's assist ambiguous — deliberate or incompetent. Pipeline accelerated regardless.

segments.outcome: Sami in a wake for the gingerbread man. R-Truth as consoler. Funeral announced for later.
segments.notes: Sami grieving wrong. Performing mourning for the disguise.

segments.outcome: Three women 'fine'. Subtle competitive friction Rhea/Charlotte; Alexa holding middle.
segments.notes: 'Everybody says they're fine' = booking planting fracture in advance. Two sovereignty archetypes (Macha vs Hera) cannot actually be fine.

segments.outcome: Truth (injured) tells Priest about Sami's grief. Priest wants Truth's trust to handle it alone. Truth: 'Trust in the Priest... Aight dawg.'
segments.notes: Genuine unity welds; performed unity (S5) plants fracture. Priest + Truth welded; Rhea + Charlotte paper-taped.

segments.outcome: Tama def. Priest (Solo as manager). Crowd 'we want Truth' — Truth came out despite Priest's plea, distracted Priest, Tama chokeslam pin. Post-match: Tongans line up behind Truth → Royce Keys' music → Solo pulls Tama back, doesn't fight Keys. Backstage: Solo to Keys 'still room in my family' — Keys threatens.
segments.notes: The verdict the scribe wasn't supposed to witness went wrong the moment the scribe appeared. Solo demoted to manager, promoted in function. Anointed unknown chose face-side. Keys/Solo magnet-repulsion, polarity not enmity.

segments.outcome: Gunther + Aldis backstage by monitor. Cody's entrance fills TV. Gunther: 'This is not how I do business.' Walks out. Aldis looks to Heyman: 'I'll handle it.'
segments.notes: Cronus in the hallway, refusing to watch the ritual. Heyman as voice of court — translating between devourer's language and building's language.

segments.outcome: Cody calls out Gunther in-ring. Heyman appears with contract. Cody: 'Have you become an advocate for Gunther?' Heyman: 'Not advocating — repaying a favor. Also a fan of Cody Rhodes.' Italy as match location proposed. Hands blank contract: 'Lock it in by yourself.' Heyman: 'Sooner or later they all meet the wise man.' Gunther 4 sleeper attempts — Cody breaks 3rd with mic, dodges 4th. 'You want the high ground. I'm SmackDown — easy to find, hard to beat.' Gunther leaves embarrassed.
segments.notes: Cody-Gunther confidence elevated to Very High. Gunther's apparatus thinner than it looked — Heyman not Vision-locked, repaying favor. Heyman's archetype self-named — Scroll 007 The Wise Man / The Constant tier.

segments.outcome: Saints def. Cardona via Roshambeau finisher.
segments.notes: Saints established as credible on SD. Cardona arc longer than this match — Exile-Returned archetype pre-assigned, receipts not closed.

segments.outcome: Danhausen zooms through a Paige + Bella Twin segment. Steals a hair (curse/voodoo prep).
segments.notes: Heyoka does sacred work in margins of someone else's mythology. Curse target ambiguous — Paige or a Bella.

segments.outcome: Paige + Brie in-ring. Paige's pop > Brie's pop. FI: 'nostalgia tour' frame. Saraya: 'We are the best we've ever been.' FI enters → Irresistible Forces (Nia + Lash) also appear. 'Whoop that trick' chant — Lash flips: 'Oh — the trick.' Pivots to dismiss Paige/Brie as 'knock-off meme girls'. Nia + Lash attack Paige + Brie. Rhea's music — cuts off ramp exit. Mid-ramp staredown.
segments.notes: Lash converted real-life burn into heel-promo instrument in one breath. Performer sovereignty. Three forces challenging the returned queen. Lash/Rhea future-gold flagged.

segments.outcome: Gingerbread man green-screened into real moments in wrestling history — full career retrospective package.
segments.notes: Production fully committed to the bit. Shadow self getting Undertaker-grade legacy treatment.

segments.outcome: 6-woman tag: Rhea/Charlotte/Alexa vs Fatal Influence. Rhea owned house solo; hot-tag to Charlotte; Jade Cargill interferes — specifically prevents Rhea from tagging back in. FI wins via interference. Post-match: Jade speaks to Alexa. Jade + Michin + B-Fab debut as faction — unnamed.
segments.notes: Macha was the surgical target. Storm orisha disrupted battle-crow's return to field. Jade-Alexa conversation: recruitment / warning / negotiation open. Faction formal naming deferred.

segments.outcome: Earlier: Keys + Fatu friendly backstage exchange (pep talk — pre-fame friendship visible on TV). Jimmy + Jey find Keys. Jey warning: 'Watch yourself, you might catch the eye of the tribal chief' [= Roman].
segments.notes: Three approaches to Keys mapped: Solo (MFT recruitment, refused), Fatu (pre-fame friendship, real history), Jey (warning on Roman's behalf). Anointed unknown navigating three gravitational fields.

segments.outcome: Danhausen chemistry lab. Cuts lights. Smoking beakers. 'If my calculations are correct... I've got a partner for Backlash.' Partner not named.
segments.notes: Heyoka summoning a tag partner via chemistry — wrong tool used with complete commitment. Mystery preserved for Tampa.

segments.outcome: Tama post-victory, looking tired. Nakamura: disappointment register, mixed English/Japanese. Talla intercedes; Nakamura scoffs in Japanese, walks off.
segments.notes: Disappointment requires prior expectation. Talla as the hold maintaining MFT loyalty. Discrimination-blindness — Japanese register the MFTs can't decode.

segments.outcome: Full in-ring funeral for gingerbread man. Trick Williams' music hits. Trick has tiny grail cup — drinks ('refreshing'), pours libation over casket. Sings eulogy with backup singers ('can somebody tell me why the gingerbread had to die'). Crowd: 'GINGERBREAD GINGERBREAD' — Sami appears. Sami crashes funeral: 'Closing out SmackDown used to mean something.' Promises to humble Trick at Backlash. Sami appears to leave; turns back; blindsides Trick with right hand. Holds US title over Trick: 'This is my life's work.' Casket opens — Lil Yachty inside dressed as gingerbread man — attacks Sami with candy-cane kendo stick. Trick recovers, hits Trick Shot. Show closes: Trick + Yachty over Sami.
segments.notes: Successor sings the predecessor's shadow to rest. Grail Cup ritual + libation — archetype pending. Sami built the weapon that destroys him. Closing image: two Black men over the predecessor — Conflagration Layer read locked.
